description: This file is a shell test script that verifies the behavior of 'safe.bareRepository' configuration in Git. It sets up repositories, runs tests to check fetching behavior with different configurations of 'safe.bareRepository', and ensures that trace outputs are correctly generated or suppressed based on the repo state and configuration.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks that 'git rev-parse --git-dir' runs successfully and the trace file contains the expected implicit bare repository info.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Verifies that with an explicit GIT_DIR, 'git rev-parse --git-dir' runs successfully without 'implicit-bare-repository' info in trace.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Checks that certain 'git rev-parse --git-dir' commands fail as expected when 'safe.bareRepository' is not appropriately set, and that trace contains the expected rejection info.
